note: RESUME OF egw5wq AT EPOCH 28, to run to epoch 40 and then hand the cards to the 0.90/0.35 arm. NOTHING ABOUT THIS ARM CHANGES: every argument is copied from launch_tokendrop_dropout_l2.sh except --resume, so the guard should report no drift. WHY GO BACK: egw5wq was stopped after epoch 27 to launch a 0.90/0.35 successor on the reading that it underfits, and the epoch-27 in-sample pass that landed after that decision says otherwise -- in-sample went 0.5421 (ep10, -0.0053 vs shipped 0.5474) to 0.5451 (ep20) to 0.5527 (ep27, +0.0053), crossing its baseline at ~epoch 23 right after the ep-21 LR drop and accelerating (+0.0030 over 10-20, +0.0076 over 20-27), with frac_acc moving for the first time (0.6992, 0.6992, 0.7127) while held-out stayed flat at +0.0051/+0.0018/+0.0035. So the head IS fitting, just late, and the open question is whether held-out follows. EPOCH 40 IS THE STOPPING POINT because --lr-steps 20:1e-3,40:1e-4 drops the rate there, so epochs 28-40 are the whole 1e-3 phase and reading the arm at that boundary measures one LR regime rather than part of two. ORIGINAL MECHANISM: BIASED TOKEN DROPOUT 0.70/0.20 + PAIR DROPOUT 0.25 + L2-SP 1e-5, fresh 60-epoch arm from the pretrained head. ONE CHANGE FROM ffj8m4, the arm it must beat: the union mask stops being a FIXED crop and becomes a PRIOR on a fresh draw each epoch -- a token inside the union survives with p=0.70, outside with p=0.20, drawn once per structure per epoch. WHY: ffj8m4 trains on one fixed 59.8% of tokens, which is memorisable, and never shows the head the periphery -- which is why o2qczq scored 0.6305 cropped and 0.5387 uncropped, below shipped 0.5474. A varying subset cannot be memorised and periphery tokens appear 20% of the time, so uncropped inference stops being a regime the head has never seen. AND IT IS FASTER: a dropped token loses its ROW AND COLUMN from z rather than being zeroed, so 0.499 of tokens is 0.249 of the original pair work against ffj8m4 0.598/0.357. TWO INVARIANTS: one draw per structure per EPOCH shared by all 50 poses, because the relative loss grades the gaps between them and per-epoch is exactly per-step under cross-seed; and every rank draws the SAME mask, seeded sha256(--seed, epoch, pdb) -- hash() is salted per process and would have given each rank a different draw. THE COST ACCEPTED: ipTM pools over the scored pair and normalises by a d0 from its token count, so a varying subset varies the achievable score while the label stays full-structure, and d0 enters nonlinearly so it does not cancel under mean-centring. ffj8m4 already carries that at a fixed 62% of each scored chain; this varies it ~45-62%. EVAL IS ALWAYS UNCROPPED: valfull every 5 epochs, the 738 winnable training interfaces every 10, both uncropped, because a cropped reading carries forced ground-truth contacts and is never a deployment number.
